CardDescription.DefaultText: The bones fall in a line toward the open sky. Within a day of this casting the eagle is hunting again, and from then on it may take game left lying on open ground whenever you are outside. The black bear cannot come within a day of this casting.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Pick the bones up and put them away.
